module_summary: Traffic light timer that counts down and reloads based on light transitions and pedestrian input.

anchors.name: ticks
anchors.why: 8-bit tick counter for traffic light timing; reloaded on light transitions or pedest button.

anchors.name: cut_short
anchors.why: Pedestrian cut-short flag: resets timer to 10 when pressed during green with sufficient time.

anchors.name: g_fall
anchors.why: Green light falling edge detector; triggers timer reload to 60 ticks.

anchors.name: y_fall
anchors.why: Yellow light falling edge detector; triggers timer reload to 5 ticks.

anchors.name: r_fall
anchors.why: Red light falling edge detector; triggers timer reload to 10 ticks.

groups.name: Timer
groups.description: Main counter register driven by state transitions and pedestrian input.

groups.name: Light Transition Detection
groups.description: Edge detectors for light state changes determining timer reload values.

groups.name: Control Logic
groups.description: Pedestrian-requested early exit condition for active green phase.
